items.title: Live: 'Star Wars is happening': $7b spend on counter-drone technology
items.description: The federal government is funnelling $7 billion into technology that can defeat other drones. Follow live.

items.title: Bitter with Australia for deporting him, he hatched a plan to get even
items.description: Eneasi Taumoefolau's 2024 arrest on drugs charges ignited fears the notoriously violent outlaw Comancheros gang had infiltrated "the Friendly Islands".

items.title: Live: Woolworths accused of misleading shoppers with 'Price dropped' tickets
items.description: Supermarket giant Woolworths faces off with the consumer watchdog in court. The ASX 200 rises at the open but later dips into the red. Follow the day's events on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: What to know about new CEO of one of world's biggest tech companies
items.description: The new CEO of Apple will be tasked with catching up in the AI race and continuing the company's legacy as a dominating force in the technology world.

items.title: Last chance for answers as police admit error in search for Nannup Four
items.description: The family of a mother and daughter who went missing, along with two others, in WA almost 20 years ago are pinning their hopes on a last-ditch effort to uncover the truth of what became of them.

items.title: Live: Trump 'unlikely' to extend ceasefire deadline as Iranian negotiator says nation won't accept peace talks
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he is unlikely to extend a ceasefire, set to expire on Wednesday night, US time.

items.title: Earthquake hits off Indonesia's Timor island
items.description: The epicentre was at a depth of 31 kilometres but there was no tsunami risk from the magnitude-6 quake, according to Indonesia's geophysics agency.

items.title: New Zealand prime minister survives confidence vote
items.description: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon says he has the support of his party after calling and winning a vote of confidence in his leadership.

items.title: Residents urged to evacuate New Zealand's capital after floods
items.description: People living in low-lying areas of New Zealand's capital city, Wellington, are urged to evacuate as heavy rain drenches the city.

items.title: Controversial rapper's bodyguard allegedly assaulted in Sydney abduction
items.description: Five people have been arrested after police rescued a controversial rapper's bodyguard who was allegedly kidnapped from his Guildford home.

items.title: Dezi Freeman's shipping container entered by YouTubers, police investigate
items.description: YouTubers are being investigated for trespass after filming inside the converted shipping container where fugitive gunman Dezi Freeman hid after shooting dead two police officers.

items.title: More women like Celine are being diagnosed with ADHD. We're not sure why
items.description: Within the sharp increase of ADHD rates in Australia lies a hidden story — more women are being prescribed medication than men. Understanding why is more complicated.

items.title: Gold Coast man awarded prestigious Medal for Gallantry for Vietnam service
items.description: Sergeant Garry Chad is awarded the Medal for Gallantry for his actions in Vietnam's Long Khahn Province in 1971 that saved several lives.

items.title: NRL overhauls training rules in landmark player safety move
items.description: The move to restrict training loads is aimed at mitigating injuries, including player head injuries, which continue to be a major issue for all contact sports.

items.title: I quit TV for a month, but the trick was what I did with my spare time
items.description: It was partly an experiment in self-control and habit-breaking, but also a response to the unhappy realisation that watching shows had become my crutch to zone out.

items.title: Six ways your smartwatch is lying to you, according to science
items.description: Wearable fitness technologies like smartwatches are worn by millions of people daily. But they're not as accurate as you might think.

items.title: Living in an apartment with your dog? Here are four things to consider
items.description: Providing opportunities for your dog to explore, giving them a safe and comfortable space to retreat to — as well as a good routine — are key to keeping your dog happy.

items.title: F1 makes 'sensible changes' after engine concerns to start season
items.description: The next Formula 1 race in Miami will be a testing and proving ground for a number of new rules aimed at improving performance and safety.

items.title: 'Outrageous mess': Around 2,000 AI road safety camera fines withdrawn in WA
items.description: About 2,000 fines valued at $1.1 million issued as a result of AI-assisted road safety cameras in WA have been withdrawn, six months after the devices were introduced.

items.title: Educators plead not guilty to assaulting students in Queanbeyan school
items.description: Four educators accused of assaulting children, aged 9 and 10, at a Queanbeyan school were not present in court when their lawyers indicated they would fight the charges.

items.title: Greyhound racing ban kept alive as independent indicates support
items.description: Upper house independent Dean Harriss, who is up for re-election next month, says he will support the Tasmanian government's ban on greyhound racing, but only if the industry compensation package is increased.

items.title: Pressure on Department of Justice after second woman dies at Perth prison
items.description: Calls are mounting for a "transparent" government review of WA's Bandyup Women's Prison after a second Aboriginal inmate dies inside the facility in less than five weeks.

items.title: Hobart to ditch hire e-scooters and bring in 'safer' e-bikes instead
items.description: The City of Hobart said e-bikes were a safer alternative to the e-scooters, which have continued to draw safety concerns from residents and visitors.

items.title: 'I know who my son is': Elijah Hollands's father posts heartfelt message
items.description: Elijah Hollands's father, former AFL player Ben Hollands, posts on social media pledging to help lift his son up and urging others to check on their friends if they are struggling.

items.title: King Charles pays tribute to 'darling Mama' on late queen's 100th birthday
items.description: The king's moving homage comes as the final master plan for the memorial for the nation's longest-serving monarch is unveiled.
